paragraphs.source_en: Kamiya Sōtan’s residence stood on the eastern side of Hakata’s West Quarter, thirteen ken wide and thirty ken deep. After the Kyushu campaign, Toyotomi Hideyoshi had Ishida Mitsunari set aside this particular plot and grant it to Sōtan. The residence had been built with an air of antique elegance. Sōtan’s favorite tea kettle rested over the hearth, its murmur faintly echoing through the room.
